headline: Source: Patriots lineman Will Campbell out with MCL sprain
summary: Patriots left tackle Will Campbell has been diagnosed with an MCL sprain in his right knee and is expected to miss some game action, a source told ESPN.

headline: Sources: Patriots' TreVeyon Henderson out multiple weeks with high ankle sprain
summary: Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson is expected to miss multiple weeks because of a high ankle sprain, sources told ESPN.

headline: Falcons Hope To Have QB Michael Penix Jr. Available For Week 6
summary: Michael Penix Jr. suffered a rib injury late in the Falcons’ Week 5 loss. The third-year quarterback is hopeful his latest ailment does not prove to be a long-term one, and the team appears to share that belief. Atlanta is optimistic Penix will be available for Week 6, Josh Kendall and Jonathan Jones of The Athletic […]

headline: Sources: Rams release kicker Mevis after miscues in loss, sign Grupe from Jets
summary: The Rams are releasing kicker Harrison Mevis and signing Blake Grupe off the Jets' practice squad, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo on Tuesday.

headline: Cowboys defense had "heart to heart" players meeting on Monday morning
summary: The Cowboys are taking steps on multiple fronts as they try to improve on a defense that has underperformed through the first five games of the season.

headline: Seven things Solak thinks entering NFL Week 6: Time for Mendoza? Cowboys issues?
summary: Get ready for Week 6 with takes on two QB situations, two teams with defensive issues, two coaches on the hot seat and more.
